notes_for_editor: Only tower-specific source is tnlandforms.us, a personal list last revised March 2016. Its names for towers 73 and up are the author's own, so the name may not be official. Group membership is inferred from list numbers: the name style changes from GA072 (title case) to GA073 (lowercase), matching the 73 split. The brief's registers field does not apply: the row has no NHLR or FFLOS entry, and the codes are from the list. The datasheet code is quoted from the list; the story does not expand it. Absence from the NHLR and FFLOS lists comes from reading their Georgia pages. Two searches run; no build, staffing, fire or fate source found. No status, access or visit facts supported.
